fields.label: Enable MCP Endpoint
fields.description: Master switch. Off means every tool refuses, whatever else is configured here.

fields.options: Tools are exposed at /api/method/synapse.mcp.handle_mcp. Callers need the MCP Agent role for the document tools, plus everything below. Frappe permissions always apply on top of this page, they are never bypassed. Raw SQL is the exception, and it ignores permissions entirely.

fields.label: Enable Read Tools
fields.description: get_doc, get_value, get_list, get_count, describe_doctype, list_available_doctypes

fields.label: Enable Write Tools
fields.description: create_doc, update_doc, set_value, submit_doc, cancel_doc, delete_doc

fields.label: Enable Read-Only SQL Tool
fields.description: Needs the separate MCP SQL Reader role. Raw SQL ignores all DocType permissions.

fields.label: Row Limit
fields.description: Rows any single call may return. Capped at 500 by the app.

fields.label: Date Format
fields.description: How dates are returned to the client. Writes always accept either form, so changing this cannot break a round trip.

fields.label: Access Mode
fields.description: Allowlist: only the DocTypes listed are reachable. Denylist: every DocType is reachable except the ones listed, and the user's own Frappe permissions become the working boundary.

fields.options: A DocType not listed here cannot be reached at all. Ticks here are a ceiling, not a grant, the user still needs the matching Frappe permission.

Everything not listed here is reachable, so the user's own Frappe permissions are what limit an agent. List what no agent should touch whatever its user may do. Token and credential DocTypes are always blocked, and schema, code and permission DocTypes (DocType, Custom Field, Server Script, Custom DocPerm, Role, User …) are always read only, whether or not they appear below.
Reading needs only the MCP Agent role. Every other action also needs one of these roles. Leave this table empty to make the endpoint read-only however the switches above are set.

fields.label: Log Field Values
fields.description: Store submitted values and before/after changes on each MCP Access Log row. Password-like fields are always masked. Untick if the data itself must not be duplicated into the log.

fields.label: Retention (Days)
fields.description: A daily job drops MCP Access Log rows older than this.
